title: 2D Shapes: Sides & Corners
subject: Mathematics
description: Circles, triangles, squares — count their sides and corners!
steps: 2D shapes are FLAT: circle, triangle, square, rectangle.
Sides are the straight lines; corners (vertices) are where sides meet.
Triangle: 3 sides, 3 corners. Square: 4 equal sides, 4 corners. Rectangle: 4 sides (2 long, 2 short). Circle: no sides, no corners!
A shape has SYMMETRY if you can fold it in half and both sides match perfectly.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a triangle have?
Which shape has NO sides and NO corners?
A square has 4 sides that are...
questions.hint: That's what makes it a square, not a rectangle.

questions.prompt: How many corners does a rectangle have?
